resources.string: No places yet. SANKET remembers a place after it loses signal there on two separate visits.
For example: use gate 3, lift B has no signal

SANKET watches your phone's signal so it can save your downloads before the signal drops.

What it reads: the signal of each SIM, whether the internet works, air pressure (to notice lifts) and your location while protection is on.

Where it goes: nowhere. Everything stays on this phone, encrypted with a key that cannot leave the phone. Apart from the downloads you start, SANKET sends nothing to any server.

What it keeps: places where you lost signal (rounded to about 11 m and forgotten after some weeks without new losses) and a safety log of losses for 30 days.

You can delete everything at any time under Privacy.
